question: In the decade of 2001-2011, which of the following state experienced a negative growth rate in population growth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• 
 Nagaland is the only state that shows a negative decade (2001-2011) growth rate** ****i.e. -0.58%,** according to 2011 census
 
 
• When the number of people inhabiting a particular area starts reducing it is known as the negative growth rate of the population.
 
• According to the 2011 census, Nagaland has a total population of 1,978,502, with males accounting for 1,024,649 and females accounting for 953,853.
 
• As per 2011 Census data, the overall literacy rate of Nagaland is 79.6%.
 
• Whereas the male and female literacy rate of Nagaland is 82.75% and 76.11% respectively.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh has also the **lowest **record of** population density **having just **17 per square kilometer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Prior to 2011, the population of the State had **two decades **of astonishing **population increase**, more than** doubling in percentage terms.**
 
• Nagaland saw a startling** 56.08% **increase in population between **1981 **and **1991**, going from from** 7.44 lakh **to **12.09 lakh.**
 
• The "trick" was repeated when the State increased from **12.09 lakh** to **19.90 lakh** in absolute terms between **1991 **and **2011**, registering a decadal growth rate of **64.41%.**
